PATCH /zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames/.description: Modify SSL configuration for a custom hostname. When sent with SSL config that matches existing config, used to indicate that hostname should pass domain control validation (DCV). Can also be used to change validation type, e.g., from 'http' to 'email'. Bundle an existing certificate with another certificate by using the "custom_cert_bundle" field. POST /zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames.description: Add a new custom hostname and request that an SSL certificate be issued for it. One of three validation methods—http, txt, email—should be used, with 'http' recommended if the CNAME is already in place (or will be soon). Specifying 'email' will send an email to the WHOIS contacts on file for the base domain plus hostmaster, postmaster, webmaster, admin, administrator. bundle_method.description: A ubiquitous bundle has the highest probability of being verified everywhere, even by clients using outdated or unusual trust stores. An optimal bundle uses the shortest chain and newest intermediates. And the force bundle verifies the chain, but does not otherwise modify it.

expires_on.description: The time the custom certificate expires on.

hosts.description: A list of Hostnames on a custom uploaded certificate.

issuer.description: The issuer on a custom uploaded certificate.

method.description: Domain control validation (DCV) method used for this hostname.

serial_number.description: The serial number on a custom uploaded certificate.

ciphers.description: An allowlist of ciphers for TLS termination. These ciphers must be in the BoringSSL format.

early_hints.description: Whether or not Early Hints is enabled.

http2.description: Whether or not HTTP2 is enabled.

tls_1_3.description: Whether or not TLS 1.3 is enabled.

signature.description: The signature on a custom uploaded certificate.

status.description: Status of the hostname's SSL certificates.

type.description: Level of validation to be used for this hostname. Domain validation (dv) must be used.

uploaded_on.description: The time the custom certificate was uploaded.
